title: BCCDC-PHL/threshold pipeline - params.project_sylph_dbs schema
description: Sylph databases per project: one row per project_id + sylph_db pair; a project may appear on several rows. The reserved sylph_db value 'default' means the --sylph_db database.

project_id.errorMessage: project_id may only contain letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens and dots (as in the samplesheet)

sylph_db.errorMessage: sylph_db must be a path to a .syldb file (no spaces), or the word 'default' for the --sylph_db database
